rounds.prompt: Nora told Amir, “I left your folder on my desk.”

rounds.prompt: Marta said, “I had already eaten, so I couldn't join the lunch.”

Marta said that she had already eaten, so she couldn't join the lunch.

rounds.explanation: Past perfect y «couldn't» no necesitan retroceder más; solo cambian los pronombres.
